decision.reason: The other side does better, so ask for more.

sides.reason: The trade value it gets and the trade value it gives are about even. The trade is one player for two or more, so the side with more players needs a margin before the sides count as even.
You keep 5 WRs in the top 36 and go from 2 TEs in the top 24 to 1, and you get the better player.
